definitions.definition: a male monarch or emperor (especially of Russia prior to 1917)
a piece of music composed for the Hungarian Csárdás dance.
definitions.example: The Csárdás is characterized by a variation in tempo: it starts out slowly (lassú) and ends in a very fast tempo (friss, literally ‘fresh’).

definitions.definition: a piece of music in the rhythm of the Hungarian Csárdás dance.
definitions.example: Classical composers who have used csárdás themes in their works include Emmerich Kálmán, Franz Liszt, Johannes Brahms, Léo Delibes, Johann Strauss, Pablo de Sarasate, Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky and others.
